segments.text: THe Condition of man, after the Fall of Adam is ſuch, That he cannot turn & prepare himſelf by his own natural ſtrength & good works, to Faith and Calling upon God: Wherefore we have no power to do Good Works pleaſant and acceptable to God, without the Grace of God by Chriſt preventing us, that we may have a good Will, and working with us when we have that good Will.
